summary: Ten sessions, 255 drives, two driver heads.

cards.p: 226 carry / 246 total over 31 drives, 2,530 rpm, strike within 1 mm of center, face-to-path +0.5°. Oct 23 after irons came close on spin (2,550) and total (241) but started the ball further right.

Path is now +5° in-to-out, the most of any session. The face follows it (face-to-path near zero on Oct 23) so the misses are pushes that start right, not slices. Closing the face half a degree to the path, as on shots 33-34, brings the finish back to the line.
Oct 21 after 9 was centered; Oct 23 averaged 11 mm low cold and 7 mm low after the irons, with the first six drives 16 mm low. Horizontal spread stayed inside ±15 mm on the clean strikes.
Spin follows delivered loft (about 190 rpm per degree). The R9 sits in the window when struck center. The Qi4D short-shaft sessions delofted to 10-16° and dropped under 2,000 rpm, which cost carry.
Standard-size grip, leave the length. At the GolfTec fitting: Qi4D Max vs standard at 12°, about 44.5", 60 g stiff mid-launch shaft (Ventus Blue 6-S class). Skip Ventus Black and the Cypher 50.

Twice now the cold first drives have been 30-40 yards right and 16 mm low. Hit the irons first, or ten unrecorded drivers, then count. Bring the CSV export so the adapter can replace the screen reads.
